name: Tuning Engine
description: Shared fine-tuning infrastructure for Möbius apps and agents: live models and methods, validated datasets, checkpointed CoreWeave Forge runs, metrics, stopping, and inference.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Tuning Engine connection status (W&B / CoreWeave Forge account it bills).

tools.name: list_methods
tools.description: Fine-tuning methods CoreWeave Forge offers now, each with its data spec, example rows and accepted hyperparameters.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Trainable base models from CoreWeave Forge, flagged serverless (base runs on Serverless Inference) and serverless_after_tuning (trained LoRA is served without deployment). Fetched live.

tools.name: upload_dataset
tools.description: Create, validate and seal a training dataset from a JSONL file path under /data or inline rows. Accepts {messages}, {prompt, completion} or Alpaca {instruction, input, output} rows. Returns dataset id.

tools.name: start_run
tools.description: Start a PAID fine-tuning run billed to the engine's W&B account. Only call after the owner explicitly approved this exact run. method sft trains on example answers; method rl samples answers from the current checkpoint, scores them with rl.reward and updates the LoRA each step (sampling is billed as inference).

rl.description: RL loop: reward {type: similarity|exact_match|json_field|contains|numeric|regex|external, field?, pattern?}, steps, prompts_per_step, samples_per_prompt, temperature, max_tokens

tools.name: run_status
tools.description: Status of one run (progress, latest checkpoint and its model URI, ETA) or, without run_id, the list of runs.

tools.name: stop_run
tools.description: Stop a run now and keep its latest saved checkpoint.

tools.name: infer
tools.description: One chat completion from a run's checkpoint (step number, 'latest', or 0 for the base model). Billed at Serverless Inference rates.

store.tagline: One shared fine-tuning engine for your Möbius apps.
store.description: Connect W&B once, then let TuningKit, purpose-built apps, and agents use the same fine-tuning infrastructure. Tuning Engine discovers current models and methods, validates app-prepared datasets, runs SFT or RL LoRA training on CoreWeave Forge, saves checkpoints, reports metrics, supports stopping, and serves inference. Each calling app sees only the datasets and runs it created. Your W&B key stays encrypted inside your installation. Preparing data does not start a paid run; training and inference may incur charges on the connected W&B account.
